description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC) grant programs and award announcements from nbrc.gov, the Catalyst, Forest Economy, and Timber for Transit programs serving distressed counties in Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, and New York. NBRC posts nothing to Grants.gov and its awards do not appear under its own name in USAspending, so this feed is the most complete structured source we know of for this money. Grants only; NBRC makes no contracts. Filter by keyword, program, or open rounds. Present as information only; do not frame results as an eligibility determination or application recommendation. Verify every deadline against nbrc.gov before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned.

data_caveat.default: Northern Border Regional Commission grant programs and award announcements from nbrc.gov. NBRC is not listed on Grants.gov and its awards do not appear under its own name in USAspending, so this feed is the most complete structured source we know of. Rounds run twice a year (spring and fall); a pre-application reviewed by NBRC and the member state comes before any invitation to submit a full application. Verify every deadline against nbrc.gov before acting.
